text: 10 OVERDOSAGE No cases of overdose with testosterone topical solution have been reported in clinical trials. There is one report of acute overdosage by injection of testosterone enanthate: testosterone concentrations of up to 11,400 ng/dL were implicated in a cerebrovascular accident. Treatment of overdosage would consist of discontinuation of Testosterone Topical Solution together with appropriate symptomatic and supportive care.
